title: Register a valid product
action: INSERT product 'Vaccine X', vaccine, 2.00-8.00 °C
expected: Product saved; new product_id returned
actual: Saved: product_id=4

title: Invalid temperature range rejected
action: INSERT product with min_temp 8, max_temp 2
expected: Rejected by CHECK (min_temp < max_temp)
actual: CheckViolation: new row for relation "product" violates check constraint "product_temp_range" [constraint product_temp_range]

title: Duplicate batch number rejected
action: INSERT a second batch with number B1
expected: Second insert rejected (UNIQUE)
actual: UniqueViolation: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "batch_batch_number_key" [constraint batch_batch_number_key]

title: Expiry before manufacture rejected
action: INSERT batch mfg 2026-05-01, expiry 2026-04-01
expected: Rejected by CHECK (expiry_date > manufacturing_date)
actual: CheckViolation: new row for relation "batch" violates check constraint "batch_dates" [constraint batch_dates]

title: Quantity boundary
action: INSERT batch with initial_quantity 0, then 1
expected: 0 rejected; 1 accepted
actual: Quantity 0 -> CheckViolation: new row for relation "batch" violates check constraint "batch_initial_quantity_check" [constraint batch_initial_quantity_check]. Quantity 1 -> saved (batch_id=7)

title: Product with batches cannot be deleted
action: DELETE product 'Vaccine A' (has batches)
expected: Rejected by foreign key (ON DELETE RESTRICT)
actual: RestrictViolation: update or delete on table "product" violates RESTRICT setting of foreign key constraint "batch_product_id_fkey" on table "batch" [constraint batch_product_id_fkey]

title: Shipment with nonexistent vehicle rejected
action: INSERT shipment with vehicle_id 999
expected: Rejected by foreign key
actual: ForeignKeyViolation: insert or update on table "shipment" violates foreign key constraint "shipment_vehicle_id_fkey" [constraint shipment_vehicle_id_fkey]

title: Same origin and destination rejected
action: INSERT shipment Warehouse -> Warehouse
expected: Rejected by CHECK (origin <> destination)
actual: CheckViolation: new row for relation "shipment" violates check constraint "shipment_route" [constraint shipment_route]

title: Add batch to shipment
action: INSERT shipment_batch (shipment, B1, 1000)
expected: Row saved in SHIPMENT_BATCH
actual: Saved: shipment 1 carries B1 x 1000

title: Same batch twice in one shipment rejected
action: INSERT shipment_batch B1 again for the same shipment
expected: Rejected (composite primary key)
actual: UniqueViolation: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "shipment_batch_pkey" [constraint shipment_batch_pkey]

title: Dispatch a shipment
action: SELECT dispatch_shipment() for B1 x400 + B2 x100 with sensor attached
expected: Status in_transit; dispatch movements and departure checkpoint recorded; stock reduced
actual: status=in_transit; dispatched movements=2; checkpoint=departure; B1 stock at origin 1000 -> 600

title: Partial failure rolls back the whole dispatch
action: dispatch_shipment() with B1 x100 (in stock) and B2 x9999 (only 500 in stock)
expected: Error raised; no movement kept for B1 or B2; status stays planned
actual: RaiseException: Insufficient stock of batch B2: 500 at origin, 9999 requested. Afterwards: movements for this shipment=0, status=planned, B1 stock=1000 (unchanged)

title: Expired or quarantined batch cannot be dispatched
action: dispatch_shipment() with an expired batch; then with a quarantined batch
expected: Dispatch rejected with a message
actual: Expired: RaiseException: Batch BEXP expired on 2026-11-07; it cannot be dispatched. Quarantined: RaiseException: Batch B1 is quarantined; it cannot be dispatched

title: Two concurrent dispatches cannot oversell stock
action: Two sessions each dispatch 800 of the 1,000 units of B1 at the same time
expected: One commits, the other fails; stock never negative
actual: Session 1 committed. Session 2 waited for the row lock (waiting=True), then: RaiseException: Insufficient stock of batch B1: 200 at origin, 800 requested. Final B1 stock at origin = 200

title: Receive a shipment
action: dispatch_shipment() then receive_shipment() for B1 x300
expected: Status delivered; stock moved to destination; sensor assignment closed
actual: status=delivered; B1 stock at destination=300; open sensor assignments=0

title: Overlapping sensor assignment rejected
action: Assign sensor S1 to a second shipment while it is still attached to the first
expected: Rejected (EXCLUDE constraint)
actual: ExclusionViolation: conflicting key value violates exclusion constraint "assignment_no_overlap" [constraint assignment_no_overlap]

title: Valid reading inside limits
action: Reading 5.2 °C from S1 on a dispatched shipment
expected: Reading saved as valid; no incident
actual: reading_id=1 stored, quality=valid; incidents=0

title: Reading outside limits raises an incident
action: Readings 5.2 °C, then 8.6 °C (vaccine limit 8 °C)
expected: Reading saved; incident created and linked to shipment, reading and batch
actual: 1 incident: id=1, type=temperature_excursion, shipment=1, source=automatic, status=open, severity=low; breaching reading linked=True

title: Repeated breach appends to the same incident
action: Readings 8.6 °C then 12.5 °C
expected: Same open incident; severity raised; no new incident
actual: incidents=1; severity low -> high; linked readings=2

title: Duplicate reading rejected
action: Same sensor and timestamp inserted twice
expected: Rejected (UNIQUE sensor_id, recorded_at)
actual: UniqueViolation: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "reading_unique_per_sensor" [constraint reading_unique_per_sensor]

title: Future timestamp stored as invalid
action: Reading 20 °C recorded 2 hours in the future
expected: Stored with quality invalid; no incident
actual: reading_id=1 stored, quality=invalid; incidents=0

title: Missing readings appear in the data-quality report
action: Readings at -45, -40, -35, -5, 0 min (5-minute sensor) -> a 30-minute hole
expected: Gap shown in the sensor quality report
actual: v_report_sensor_quality for S1: gaps=1, longest_gap_minutes=30

title: Original reading values are protected
action: UPDATE the temperature of a stored reading; DELETE it; UPDATE only its quality flag
expected: Value change and delete rejected by trigger; quality flag change allowed
actual: UPDATE value -> RaiseException: Original values of reading 1 cannot be changed; only quality_status may be updated. DELETE -> RaiseException: Sensor readings cannot be deleted (reading 1). Quality flag update -> allowed; temperature still 5.00

title: Trace affected batches
action: Reading 10.1 °C on a shipment carrying vaccine (2-8 °C) and syrup (2-25 °C)
expected: Only the batches whose own limits were breached are linked
actual: Linked batches: ['B1'] (B3 syrup, limit 25 °C, correctly not linked)

title: Login with a wrong password
action: POST /api/auth/login with a valid email and a wrong password
expected: 401 Unauthorized; no token issued
actual: Wrong password -> HTTP 401 {'detail': 'Incorrect email or password'}. Correct password -> HTTP 200 with a token

title: Unauthorised status change rejected (API and database)
action: Operator calls POST /api/batches/B1/status 'released'; operator context runs the UPDATE directly in SQL
expected: Rejected by the API (403) and by the database trigger
actual: API -> HTTP 403 {'detail': 'Requires role: investigator, quality_manager'}. Direct SQL -> InsufficientPrivilege: Role operator may not change batch B1 from available to on_hold

title: SQL injection attempt
action: GET /api/batches?q=' OR 1=1 --
expected: Treated as plain text; no extra rows
actual: All batches: 5 rows. Injection string -> HTTP 200, 0 rows (searched literally)

title: Application role cannot delete readings or write the audit log
action: As pharmatrace_app: DELETE FROM sensor_reading; INSERT INTO audit_log
expected: Permission denied
actual: DELETE readings -> InsufficientPrivilege: permission denied for table sensor_reading. INSERT audit_log -> InsufficientPrivilege: permission denied for table audit_log

title: Complete an investigation
action: Mark investigation completed without findings; then with findings
expected: Rejected without findings; with findings completed_at is recorded
actual: Without findings -> CheckViolation: new row for relation "investigation" violates check constraint "investigation_findings" [constraint investigation_findings]. With findings -> completed (completed_at recorded=True)

title: Closing an incident too early is refused
action: Resolve the incident, then close it while a corrective action is pending (and batches unassessed)
expected: Rejected with the reason shown
actual: With a pending action -> RaiseException: Incident 1 has corrective actions that are not finished. With the action done but batches unassessed -> RaiseException: Incident 1 has affected batches that are not assessed

title: Close a fully resolved incident
action: All work done; investigator tries to close; quality manager closes
expected: Only the QM can close; status closed; audit entry
actual: Investigator -> InsufficientPrivilege: Only a quality manager can close an incident. Quality manager -> closed. Latest audit entry: incident_status=closed, changed_by=Quality Manager

title: Dashboard counts match base tables
action: Compare v_dashboard with direct COUNT queries
expected: Every dashboard number equals the matching SQL count
actual: v_dashboard (active shipments, open incidents, batches under investigation) = (1, 1, 2); direct counts = (1, 1, 2)

title: Incident report totals match
action: SUM of v_report_incidents_by_type_severity vs COUNT(*) FROM incident
expected: Report total equals the table count
actual: Report total=1; COUNT(*) FROM incident=1

title: Required-field and range validation
action: POST /api/shipments without destination; POST /api/products with min 8 > max 2
expected: 422 with a message naming the problem; nothing saved
actual: Shipment -> HTTP 422, missing fields ['destination_facility_id', 'expected_arrival']. Product -> HTTP 422, 'Value error, Minimum temperature must be below maximum temperature'. Shipments saved: 0
